# Env — design (M8)

Agreed with the user on 2026-11-02 ("carry on with the suggested items") after the M8 design debate. M8 is not in the plan file; this debate is its source. Its goal: through the web UI only, point the platform at a repo and a branch holding a buggy price / discount% feature on Item, and get tests, located defects, suggested fixes and a retest. Happy path on this one repo.

| # | Decision | Agreed | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| D18 | Warm start | Confirming the repo on New run brings the reference stack up (idempotent) while the user types | Ready by the time Start is pressed |
| D19 | Reference = branch | `reference` is built from the chosen branch's commit; the fingerprint records it | The buggy feature is what gets tested |
| D20 | Fix variants | `fixed:<patch>` also accepts a patch held as an artifact (from triage's suggested fix), not only `sut/patches/<name>.patch`. A `commit:<sha>` variant builds a later commit of the same branch | "Try suggested fix" and "Retest my fix" (retest D16) |
| D21 | Seeded variants | `bug:*` variants only when seeded bugs are on | sut D12 |
